entries.content_plain: 3. in the dance-- ( Psa 30:11 ). The dance is connected with other terms, expressive of the great joy of the occasion. The word may be rendered "lute," to which the other instruments are joined. sing praises-- or, sing and play.

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7156"/><div sID="gen10974" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7156"/><hi type="bold">5. in glory--</hi>the honorable condition to which they are raised.<div eID="gen10974" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10975" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">upon their beds--</hi>once a place of mourning (<reference osisRef="Ps.6.6">Psa 6:6</reference>). <div eID="gen10975" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 5. in glory-- the honorable condition to which they are raised. upon their beds-- once a place of mourning ( Psa 6:6 ).
entries.reader_content_plain: 5. in glory-- the honorable condition to which they are raised. upon their beds-- once a place of mourning ( Psa 6:6 ).

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7159"/><div sID="gen10978" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7159"/><hi type="bold">9. the judgment written--</hi>either in God's decrees, or perhaps as in <reference osisRef="Deut.32.41-Deut.32.43">De 32:41-43</reference>.<div eID="gen10978" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10979" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">this honour--</hi>that is, to be thus employed, will be an honorable service, to be assigned<div eID="gen10979" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10980" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">his saints--</hi>or, godly ones (<reference osisRef="Ps.16.3">Psa 16:3</reference>). <chapter eID="Ps.149"/>
entries.content_plain: 9. the judgment written-- either in God's decrees, or perhaps as in De 32:41-43 . this honour-- that is, to be thus employed, will be an honorable service, to be assigned his saints-- or, godly ones ( Psa 16:3 ).
entries.reader_content_plain: 9. the judgment written-- either in God's decrees, or perhaps as in De 32:41-43 . this honour-- that is, to be thus employed, will be an honorable service, to be assigned his saints-- or, godly ones ( Psa 16:3 ).
